title: 104 U-format TESTFR act
purpose: Cover the documented 104 U-format control-only entry point using the exact published control bytes for test frame activation.
expected_behavior: A 104 implementation should parse this as a valid U-format APDU and identify the control field as TESTFR act without attempting ASDU parsing.
constraints_preserved: APDU length is 0x04 because only the four control bytes follow
Control bytes exactly match documented TESTFR act values 43 00 00 00
No ASDU bytes are appended because U-format does not carry ASDU data
issue_safety_notes: Purely documented control-frame seed with no issue-related structure.
